name: Reading Passage Rubric
subject: English
description: Custom reading passage rubric based on pronunciation, expression, and delivery.

criteria.name: Pronunciation
criteria.description: Reading aloud pronunciation: assesses whether words and beginning and ending sounds are pronounced correctly and clearly.

rubric_levels.description: Pronounces most words incorrectly. Pronounces only a few beginning and ending sounds.
Pronounces some words correctly and clearly. Pronounces some beginning and ending sounds.
Pronounces all words correctly and clearly. Pronounces all beginning and ending sounds.

criteria.name: Expression
criteria.description: Reading aloud expression: assesses pitch and tone while reading the passage.

rubric_levels.description: Shows very little distinction in pitch and tone.
Uses appropriate pitch and tone most of the time.
Uses appropriate pitch and tone at all times.

criteria.name: Delivery
criteria.description: Reading aloud oral delivery: assesses smoothness, pauses, and hesitation while reading the passage.

rubric_levels.description: Reads slowly and jerkily, with inappropriate pauses and awkward hesitation.
Reads smoothly most of the time, with mostly appropriate pauses and some hesitation.
Reads very smoothly throughout, with appropriate pauses and no hesitation.
